title: Theoretical Analysis of Diffusion Models
description: Investigating the statistical properties of denoising diffusion models, particularly the relationship between predicted-noise characteristics and generative fidelity. The research examines covariance structure, trace-energy behavior, and regularization strategies for improving the statistical properties of model predictions.
highlights: Statistical analysis of predicted noise in diffusion models.
Investigation of covariance structure and trace-energy behavior.
Exploration of regularization strategies and their relationship to generative fidelity.
Evaluation through theoretical analysis and numerical experiments.
imageAlt: Conceptual illustration of noise evolving into coherent structure through a diffusion process

title: Image Colorization Using Implicit Neural Representations
description: Investigating image colorization using implicit neural representations, where continuous coordinate-based neural models reconstruct image color information under sparse color guidance. The work studies the role of image structure, color constraints, and guided optimization in recovering plausible color representations.
highlights: Coordinate-based implicit neural representations.
Image colorization formulated as an inverse problem.
Sparse color-hint guidance and reconstruction constraints.
Investigation of spatial structure and color propagation.

output.label: Manuscript under review at ICLR 2027
output.title: Colour-INR: Implicit Neural Representation for Image Colorization through Colour Guidance

imageAlt: Conceptual grayscale-to-color reconstruction guided by sparse color points and a coordinate grid

title: Preterm Birth Prediction From EHG and Tocographic Signals
description: Developing signal-processing and machine-learning methods for preterm birth classification using electrohysterography and tocographic recordings. The research investigates time-frequency representations, empirical mode decomposition, interpretable feature extraction, and robust model evaluation.
highlights: Spectral, statistical, entropy-based, and time-frequency features.
Empirical mode decomposition and intrinsic mode functions.
Machine-learning classification with recording-level evaluation.
Investigation of signal segmentation and preprocessing strategies.

output.label: Manuscript under review at PLOS ONE
output.title: Empirical Mode Decomposition and Interpretable Machine Learning for Preterm Birth Classification from Electrohysterography

imageAlt: Conceptual EHG waveforms, decomposed signal components, and time-frequency patterns

title: Soil Composition and Texture Classification Using Multispectral Imaging
description: Developed reflectance multispectral imaging and machine-learning methods for estimating soil grain-size composition and classifying USDA soil texture. The work combines a custom multispectral imaging system with image preprocessing, spectral feature analysis, regression, and classification.
highlights: Reflectance multispectral imaging with 13 illumination bands.
Estimation of clay, silt, and sand proportions.
USDA texture classification.
Imaging calibration, preprocessing, and model evaluation.

output.label: Published in IEEE Access
output.title: Reflectance Multispectral Imaging for Soil Grain-Size Composition Estimation and USDA Texture Classification

imageAlt: Conceptual soil grain textures illuminated by multiple spectral bands for optical sensing

title: Microcystis and Microcystin Estimation Using Multispectral Imaging
description: Investigated transmission-mode multispectral imaging and machine-learning regression methods for estimating Microcystis cell concentration and ELISA-equivalent microcystin concentration in water samples, with emphasis on non-destructive optical measurements and quantitative analysis.
highlights: Transmission-mode multispectral imaging.
Spectral feature extraction and regression.
Microcystis cell-concentration estimation.
Comparison with reference measurements for microcystin estimation.

output.label: Manuscript in preparation
output.title: Experimental work completed; manuscript preparation continues

title: Feature-Conditioned Diffusion for Audio Generation
description: Investigated feature-conditioned diffusion models for audio generation, extending diffusion-based audio synthesis through signal-processing representations and evaluating the influence of additional conditioning information on generated audio.
highlights: Diffusion-based audio generation.
Feature-conditioned generative modeling.
Signal-processing representations.
Evaluation of generative audio models.

output.title: Feature Conditioned Diffusion for Audio Generation · IEEE ICIIS 2025

title: Soil Moisture Estimation and Classification Using Multispectral Imaging
description: Investigated reflectance multispectral imaging and machine-learning methods for soil-moisture estimation and classification through moisture-induced spectral variations. The research combines spectral image acquisition, learning-based regression, and classification to study the relationship between soil moisture and optical response.
highlights: Reflectance multispectral image acquisition and preprocessing.
Deep-learning-based soil-moisture estimation.
Analysis of moisture-induced changes in spectral responses.
Learning-based soil classification.

title: Survey Buddy — Electronic Land Surveying Device
description: Designed and developed a portable electronic surveying device for mapping terrain and elevation. Integrated GPS, motion sensing, and barometric altitude measurement with wireless data transmission, alongside custom PCB design, 3D-printed enclosure development, and product packaging.
highlights: GPS, accelerometer, and barometric sensing for terrain and elevation mapping.
Wireless transmission of surveyed data to a computer.
Custom PCB design, 3D-printed enclosure, and complete product development.
imageAlt: Conceptual terrain-surveying instrument transmitting GPS and sensor data to mapping software

title: GloSmart — Smart Cycling Safety Glove
description: Developed an ATmega328P-based wearable cycling safety system programmed in assembly language. Integrated accelerometer-based hand-gesture recognition, nRF24L01 wireless signaling, and GPS/GSM-based collision alerts.
highlights: ATmega328P microcontroller programmed in assembly language.
Accelerometer-based gesture detection for bicycle turn-signal control.
Wireless glove-to-bicycle communication and GPS/GSM collision-alert functionality.
imageAlt: Conceptual cyclist using a motion-sensing smart glove connected wirelessly to bicycle safety lights

title: Non-Invasive Blood Glucose Sensor
description: Developed an experimental infrared glucose-sensing prototype using optical detection, analog signal conditioning, and microcontroller-based acquisition. Evaluated sensor response using glucose solutions of different concentrations.
highlights: Infrared LED and photodiode sensing arrangement.
Analog filtering, signal conditioning, and Arduino Nano-based data acquisition.
Experimental evaluation using prepared glucose solutions.
imageAlt: Conceptual infrared LED and photodiode prototype evaluating prepared glucose solutions with signal-conditioning electronics
